Line: Hey, I know [Name] on [Street] loves ice cream.
My friend [Name] on [Street] has a big family and is always buying ice cream.
[Name] buys ice cream almost every day. They're usually babysitting. They're on [Street].
[Name] on [Street] works from home and takes an ice cream break every evening.
[Name] on [Street] coaches a kids' soccer team and buys for everyone after practice.
[Name] on [Street] always has friends over in the summer. They'll want a lot.
[Name] on [Street] just got paid. They'll be looking for you.
If you're near [Street], look for [Name]. Never says no to ice cream.
[Name] on [Street] has a cookout pretty much every night.
[Name] on [Street] gets a big allowance and spends it all on ice cream.
[Name] on [Street] buys for their whole Little League team.
[Name] on [Street] says they're training for a competition. The competition is ice cream.
[Name] on [Street] says ice cream counts as a vegetable if you eat it outside.
[Name] on [Street] told the doctor they'd eat more greens. Mint chip counts, apparently.
[Name] on [Street] is hiding from the in-laws. Your truck is their excuse to go out.
[Name] on [Street] lost a bet and has to buy ice cream for the whole street all summer.
[Name] on [Street] dances every time they hear your music. Dances to the piggy bank.
[Name] on [Street] bought a second freezer just for ice cream. It's always empty.
[Name] on [Street] sells your ice cream at the pool for double. Smart kid.
[Name] on [Street] just found their birthday money. All of it.
[Name] on [Street] calls your truck's song "the dinner bell."
[Name] on [Street] tells everyone they're on a diet. A diet of ice cream.
[Name] on [Street] says they have a fever, a fever for more ice cream.
Don't tell anyone, but [Name] on [Street] is eating their feelings. Lots of feelings.
[Name] on [Street] lost their job. Now they sit on the porch eating ice cream all night.
[Name] on [Street] lost their cat. They put ice cream on the porch every night, hoping.
The doctor told [Name] on [Street] to cut back. They didn't.
[Name] on [Street] thinks the world ends soon. They want all the ice cream first.
[Name] on [Street] stress-eats ice cream. Their landlord has been knocking a lot lately.
[Name] on [Street] failed every class this year. Ice cream is the only thing going right.
[Name] on [Street] says ice cream is cheaper than therapy. Not as good, but cheaper.
[Name] on [Street] got dumped at recess. They're coping the only way they know how.
[Name] on [Street] is building a statue of you out of popsicle sticks. Needs more sticks.
[Name] on [Street] thinks your truck is a spaceship. They buy a lot so you won't leave.
[Name] on [Street] feeds a raccoon called The Mayor. The Mayor only eats ice cream.
[Name] on [Street] is filling a swimming pool with ice cream. It's going slowly.
[Name] on [Street] says they'll melt if they stop eating ice cream. I don't ask.
[Name] on [Street] is training an army of squirrels. They pay them in ice cream.
[Name] on [Street] collects wrappers. They say they are close to a world record.
[Name] on [Street] thinks your music has secret messages. They buy more to hear the rest.
[Name] on [Street] is writing a review of your ice cream. They're doing lots of research.
[Name] on [Street] is having a holla-a-hooping competition. It is heating up.
